points.title: Requester write Setup cycle
points.condition: i_apb_psel=1, i_apb_penable=0, i_apb_pwrite=1

points.title: Requester read Setup cycle
points.condition: i_apb_psel=1, i_apb_penable=0, i_apb_pwrite=0

points.title: Write completes without error
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1, o_apb_pslverr=0, transfer captured as write

points.title: Write completes with error
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1, o_apb_pslverr=1, transfer captured as write

points.title: Read completes without error
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1, o_apb_pslverr=0, transfer captured as read

points.title: Read error with nonzero read data forwarded
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1, o_apb_pslverr=1, read, o_apb_prdata nonzero

points.title: Completion after 8 or more requester wait cycles
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1 after at least 8 Access cycles with PREADY low

points.title: Completion after 32 or more requester wait cycles
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1 after at least 32 Access wait cycles

points.title: Completion after 128 or more requester wait cycles
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1 after at least 128 Access wait cycles

points.title: Back-to-back Setup right after PREADY cycle
points.condition: Setup cycle in the cycle right after a PREADY cycle

points.title: Back-to-back write then read
points.condition: back-to-back Setup, previous write, new read

points.title: Back-to-back read then write
points.condition: back-to-back Setup, previous read, new write

points.title: Back-to-back write then write
points.condition: back-to-back Setup, previous write, new write

points.title: Back-to-back read then read
points.condition: back-to-back Setup, previous read, new read

points.title: Setup after idle period of 4 or more cycles
points.condition: Setup cycle after at least 4 idle cycles with PSEL low

points.title: Error-free transfer following an error transfer
points.condition: PREADY without PSLVERR when previous transfer ended with error

points.title: Consecutive error transfers
points.condition: PREADY with PSLVERR when previous transfer ended with error

points.title: Address all ones in Setup
points.condition: Setup cycle with all address bits 1

points.title: Write with full strobes at word-aligned address
points.condition: write Setup, all strobes 1, address multiple of 4

points.title: Write with partial or zero strobes at misaligned address
points.condition: write Setup, not all strobes 1, address not multiple of 4

points.title: Read with nonzero PSTRB forwarded
points.condition: read Setup with at least one strobe bit 1

points.title: PPROT equal 0 in Setup
points.condition: Setup with PPROT=0

points.title: PPROT equal 7 in Setup
points.condition: Setup with PPROT=7

points.title: PPROT with a single bit set in Setup
points.condition: Setup with PPROT one-hot

points.title: Requester changes fields during Access
points.condition: Access wait cycle where address or write flag differs from Setup capture

points.title: APB5 wake-up high at Setup
points.condition: Setup cycle with i_apb_pwakeup=1

points.title: Requester wake-up low at Setup
points.condition: Setup cycle with i_apb_pwakeup=0

points.title: Request user attributes nonzero
points.condition: Setup with nonzero PAUSER or write with nonzero PWUSER

points.title: Response user attributes nonzero at completion
points.condition: PREADY with nonzero PBUSER or read with nonzero PRUSER

points.title: Requester-domain reset hit a transfer in flight
points.condition: first cycle after reset release following reset during a transfer

points.title: Requester domain active while slave domain in reset
points.condition: i_rst_n_mst high, i_rst_n_slv low (stable level)

points.title: Completer-side write Setup
points.condition: o_apb_psel=1, o_apb_penable=0, o_apb_pwrite=1

points.title: Completer-side read Setup
points.condition: o_apb_psel=1, o_apb_penable=0, o_apb_pwrite=0

points.title: Completer ready in first Access cycle
points.condition: Access with i_apb_pready=1 and no earlier wait

points.title: Completer wait of 4 or more cycles
points.condition: Access ends after at least 4 wait cycles

points.title: Completer wait of 32 or more cycles
points.condition: Access ends after at least 32 wait cycles

points.title: Completer error response at end of Access
points.condition: Access with i_apb_pready=1 and i_apb_pslverr=1

points.title: Completer PREADY during Setup cycle
points.condition: o_apb_psel=1, o_apb_penable=0, i_apb_pready=1

points.title: Completer-domain reset hit a transfer in flight
points.condition: first cycle after slv reset release following reset during a completer transfer
